class ExpiryWarningTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.o = Organizer.objects.create(name='Dummy', slug='dummy')
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            self.event = Event.objects.create(
                organizer=self.o, name='Dummy', slug='dummy',
                date_from=now() + timedelta(days=30),
                plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer,tests.testdummy'
            )
            self.order = Order.objects.create(
                code='FOO', event=self.event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
                status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
                datetime=now() - timedelta(days=4),
                expires=now() + timedelta(days=2),
                total=Decimal('46.00'),
                sales_channel=self.event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
            )
            djmail.outbox = []

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sent_within_default_window(self):
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
        assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@dummy.test']
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.expiry_reminder_sent

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_disabled_with_zero_days(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 0
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert not self.order.expiry_reminder_sent

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_before_window(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 1
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sent_once(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_paid_order(self):
        self.order.status = Order.STATUS_PAID
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_already_expired_order(self):
        self.order.expires = now() - timedelta(hours=1)
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_valid_if_pending_order(self):
        self.order.valid_if_pending = True
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_order_requiring_approval(self):
        self.order.require_approval = True
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_order_with_cancellation_fee(self):
        OrderFee.objects.create(
            order=self.order, fee_type=OrderFee.FEE_TYPE_CANCELLATION, value=Decimal('5.00'),
        )
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
